subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should OpenClaw ship a focused first-class Anthropic server-compaction option now, or first define a broader Anthropic context-management/passthrough contract that also covers the overlapping request?
rationale: Both choices create a compatibility-sensitive public configuration and provider behavior contract; source evidence alone cannot determine the intended long-term surface or precedence with local compaction.

options.title: Focused native compaction
options.body: Define a narrow opt-in Anthropic server-compaction setting and its local-compaction interaction, while leaving other Anthropic beta features to separate work.

options.title: Broader context-management contract
options.body: Resolve server compaction together with beta-header passthrough and related context-management features under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54041.

recommendation.title: Focused native compaction
recommendation.body: Define a narrow opt-in Anthropic server-compaction setting and its local-compaction interaction, while leaving other Anthropic beta features to separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work and the existing issue discussion connect this person most directly to the Anthropic transport and compaction decision surface.
